description: This file contains utility functions for loading configuration files from S3 and GCS, including functions to retrieve YAML configurations and download Python files, with logging and error handling.

classes.name: GCSBucketLogger
classes.description: Logger class for interacting with GCS buckets, used for downloading objects asynchronously.

methods.name: get_file_contents_from_s3
methods.description: Retrieves and parses a YAML configuration file from an S3 bucket using boto3.

methods.name: get_config_file_contents_from_gcs
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves and parses a YAML configuration file from a GCS bucket.

methods.name: download_python_file_from_s3
methods.description: Downloads a Python file from S3 and saves it locally, with directory creation.

methods.name: download_python_file_from_gcs
methods.description: Asynchronously downloads a Python file from GCS and saves it locally.
